answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 3 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, so that paying the pulse bond on all of them and exposing each to the sonnet slash. Because the ridge audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Honest users pay that once, farms 25 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
